jobs.description: Build data ingestion and ELT workflows that bring database and file data into Snowflake with AWS, dbt, and Python. Maintain more than 70 dbt models and reusable transformations that make warehouse data consistent and ready for analysis. Validate pipelines and data releases with automated checks and reconciliation, supporting 98% reconciliation accuracy. Improve Tableau dashboard performance and reliability, reducing load times by about 60%, and work with stakeholders to define shared metrics.

Built and maintained Power BI, Tableau, and QlikView dashboards, working with teams to define useful KPIs. Designed data structures and API workflows that brought information together for analysis and dashboard use. Automated data preparation with Python, Power Query, and DAX, improving dashboard refresh performance by 35% and reducing manual work by 12%. Developed forecasting and classification analysis to help teams understand performance and operational trends.

Prepared and analyzed financial data with Python, pandas, and NumPy to identify useful patterns. Built and evaluated classification and regression models to estimate risk and support forecasting. Created Tableau dashboards that made model results and trends easier to explore. Explained findings in clear terms so stakeholders could use the analysis in their decisions.

Designed data warehouse structures and ETL workflows that combined information from multiple source systems. Built Tableau dashboards and analysis views to make operational trends easier to understand. Supported large data migrations and validated records for completeness and accuracy. Used SQL, Python, and statistical analysis to improve data preparation and answer business questions.
